p1_findings.description: No bundled prototype HTML was supplied; visual design and verbatim Thai copy could not be extracted.

p1_findings.description: Brand color tokens are TBD (no spec/prototype), so brand-on-background WCAG contrast cannot be computed or gated.

p1_findings.description: Every Thai (th) microcopy value is TBD-extract-from-prototype; the storefront is Thai-market and cannot ship copy in English only.
